title: Collection of Carbon Tax and Release of Information for Carbon Tax Collections
what_it_is: Collection of Carbon Tax and Release of Information for Carbon Tax Collections

sections.label: Carbon Pricing Act carbon tax
sections.summary: The Carbon Pricing Act, in force from 1 January 2019, imposes a $5 per tonne carbon tax on large emitters, with reports and payments due in 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The Carbon Pricing Act (CPA) came into force on 1 January 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: CPA gives effect to the carbon tax of $5 per tonne of carbon dioxide equivalent (tCO2e), to be paid using carbon credits purchased from the National Environment Agency (NEA).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The carbon tax applies to facilities in the manufacturing, power generation, waste and water management sectors which emit 25,000 tonnes of carbon dioxide or more annually.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: These companies have been monitoring their emissions for the year 2019 and must submit verified emissions reports to NEA by 30 June 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Companies must pay their 2019 carbon tax liability by 30 September 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The carbon tax revenues will be published annually in the Government's Budget Book, which is released in the first quarter of each year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The Government is unable to disclose company- or facility-specific data due to data confidentiality requirements as provided for in CPA.

sections.label: Companies affected by Act
sections.summary: The number of companies affected by this Act is very small, around 40.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The number of companies that are affected by this Act is very small, around 40.
